name: Dividing roles
goalName: Create and divide roles within the team
goal: A project needs to have leaders and managers responsible for specific tasks or parts of the project. At the start of the project, these roles need to be decided and divided across the team.

approach.text: I discussed with my teammates what roles we need for the project, and we came up with a list. We also came up with leads in specific parts of the project, such as design and programming. These people will be contacted if there are questions during development and will be involved when decisions are made in these areas.

normalLearnings: I can create roles suitable for game design projects.
I can divide roles within a project to make every have some responsibility over the project.
result:
The roles in the project are divided as follows:
Scrum Master - Jelmer de Rooij
Contact Person - Lucas Mols
Git Manager - Atanas Georgiev
Note Taker - Sander Theeuwen
Lead Designer - Sicong Nie
Lead 3D Modeling - Lucas Mols
Lead Programmer - Atanas Georgiev
Lead Sound Design - Jelmer de Rooij & Sander Theeuwen
Lead VFX - Omar Abdin
Combined Scene Manager - Sicong Nie
Programmer - Everyone

With this division, everyone has some responsibility of the project.
validation: The rest of the team agreed with this division of roles. If needed, the roles will change throughout the project.
contribution: This division will contribute to the management and control of the project, as it is clear who to reach out to with specific problems and consult with making decisions. It also increases the proffesionality of the project, because the responsibilities of the project are divided, just like real companies.
